risk_notes: Sequenced first because the defect actively blocks MCP tool calls from any client that appends a client suffix to the model name — it degrades every other workflow in the repo, including the agents that will implement the remaining seven tickets. Risk: normalization that is too aggressive could silently resolve a genuinely wrong model and mis-price a call, so keep it strictly a post-exact and post-substring fallback and emit the soft warning on every non-exact resolution. Second risk: placing normalization in the transport wrapper means each MCP server binary must pick it up — verify every server actually routes through the shared wrapper rather than constructing Gate directly.
